title: Where Your Yes Begins
style: Electronic Welsh folk with a steady, measured pulse; modal fiddle and harp phrases threaded through restrained synth bass and crisp electronic percussion, with subtle Welsh folk ornamentation. Male baritone in natural American English pronunciation, close and conversational in the verses, opening into a more melodic refrain. Build from a spare, intimate opening into a fuller but controlled chorus, then strip back for a reflective bridge and resolve with a quiet final refrain. Clear, detailed mix with organic strings against precise electronic rhythm.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Rotterdam, the eighth of July
Same arrival, same late sky
Two queen beds, one careful line
“Don’t touch me unless I ask this time”
You let the silence hold its shape
Then crossed the room and slipped away
Bare as daylight, calm and sure
I stayed beside the closed-off door

[Pre-Chorus]
Morning came; you came to me
Your kiss was yours to freely give
I reached too far, you drew the line
And I heard what you had said that night

[Chorus]
I was disappointed, I won’t pretend
Not in you, but in the story in my head
You owed me nothing, not a thing
I mistook a hope for an opening
So I’ll meet you where your yes begins
And leave the rest where it has been

[Verse 2]
Cafeteria, coffee, plates
By noon we’d crossed the airport gates
A quiet flight, two strangers aboard
One polished smile I chose to ignore
In the cabin, films rolled by
Avengers filling up the sky
A borrowed world, an easy place
To let the hours pass without a chase

[Chorus]
I was disappointed, I won’t pretend
Not in you, but in the story in my head
You owed me nothing, not a thing
I mistook a hope for an opening
So I’ll meet you where your yes begins
And leave the rest where it has been

[Verse 3]
Teterboro, fuel and another flight
Dallas waiting past the night
A doctor sat across from me
Her quiet held its privacy
Headphones on, I let the moment pass
Woke to wheels and window glass
She thanked me, then was gone from view
A brief hello I never knew

[Bridge]
No hidden promise in a kiss
No debt inside a kindness
The line was clear; I crossed it once
I can learn without resentment

[Final Chorus]
I was disappointed, I won’t pretend
Not in you, but in the story in my head
You owed me nothing, not a thing
I mistook a hope for an opening
At the hotel, you said I could
I waited, heard you, understood
This time the choice was yours to make
And I was there because you asked

[Outro]
Rotterdam to Dallas, miles behind
A quieter thought I carry this time
Your yes was yours; your no was too
That’s the truth I owe to you
